notes: Generated from a segment-grouped cross-validation experiment over the 479 WOD-E2E validation preference frames.
Selector ridge 100.0 was chosen by a local-RFS sweep over 0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0, and 100.0 before official-RFS confirmation.
Selector target frame_delta was chosen by local-RFS improvement before official-RFS confirmation.
Squared selector features improved earlier selector sweeps, but contextual source-by-speed and source-by-intent features beat the squared current baseline in matched official-RFS CV.
Source indicator features were added after a matched local-RFS smoke improved the no-anchor baseline, then confirmed on official RFS.
Temporal-summary proposal candidates improved a matched official-RFS 100-frame smoke from 6.9623 to 7.1977 selected RFS.
Base plus temporal-summary candidates improved the full 479-frame official-RFS CV selected score from 7.4463 to 7.4738.
Contextual selector features improved the matched full 479-frame official-RFS CV selected score from 7.4738 to 7.5438.
Trajectory ridge 30.0 improved the matched full 479-frame official-RFS CV selected score from 7.5438 to 7.6028 after a local-RFS sweep over ridge 1.0, 30.0, and 100.0.
Replacing the base feature set with temporal_summary alone regressed full selected RFS to 7.4275, so temporal is used only as an auxiliary candidate source.
This is an internal held-out development benchmark, not a leaderboard score.
Simulator code and simulator metrics were not used.
